title_sq: Shitet Apartament 1+1 te Rr. Kosovareve te United Tower Residence
description_sq: Fare prane parkut te Liqenit, te Rr. Kosovareve, kemi per shitje nje apartament 1+1 i cili ne residencen United Tower. Apartamenti eshte ne faze ndertimi, dhe ndodhet ne katin e 11-te. Apartamenti ka nje strukture banimi kuadratike. Vendodhja e ketij apartamenti, i jep banoreve potencial te residences, nje mundesi te arte per shfrytezimin e parkut te liqenit, mundeson nje akses te kollajte te unazes se adhe te Tiranes, dhe gjithashtu lidhet shume lehte me zonat kryesore te qytetit.
title_en: Apartment 1+1 for sale at Rr. Kosovars of United Tower Residence
description_en: Right next to the Lake Park, on Rr. Kosovars, we have for sale a 1+1 apartment in the United Tower residence. The apartment is under construction, and is located on the 11th floor. The apartment has a square residential structure. The location of this apartment gives the potential residents of the residence a golden opportunity to use the lake park, allows easy access to the ring road of Tirana, and is also easily connected to the main areas of the city.
